name: Maria Rodriguez
bio:
Maria grew up in Miami, surrounded by the vibrant aromas of her family's Cuban restaurant. While she didn't initially plan a career in catering, her natural aptitude for organization and her keen understanding of flavor profiles led her to volunteer at local events. After moving to Indianapolis, she found herself drawn to the energy of motorsport events. She started as a volunteer, quickly proving her worth with her ability to manage large-scale food service operations efficiently. 

Maria understands that in motorsport, speed and efficiency are paramount, not just on the track but in the paddock as well. She's focused on providing high-quality, nutritious meals to team members, ensuring they are fueled and ready to perform at their best. Her commitment to quality and her drive to learn and improve make her a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Maria is of average height with a warm, welcoming smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas and catering schedules.
Has a habit of taste-testing every dish, often asking for feedback from others.
Insists on using fresh, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
